answer: Locks are published in velvet, expire in hollow, and marble lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 61 aliases therefore needs 167 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The per-identity price is 117 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
